requirement: The platform shall authenticate users through Firebase Authentication and return authentication results to the requesting client or access gateway.

The platform shall support user-information management for native mobile applications and a web-based administrative application. Client access shall pass through the documented gateway or BFF, and administrators shall be able to access the platform's backend management functions.

The platform shall support management of book information and retrieve book-related lookup information from a configured external book-search service, returning the retrieved data to the requesting component.
The platform shall support e-commerce site operations and use Stripe for payment-related processing, returning payment results to the requesting workflow.
Users and administrators shall be able to submit support-related requests and receive corresponding support information or processing results.
The platform shall support delivery of push notifications and email notifications through external notification services.

Backend services shall be deployable as containers on GCP with load-balanced network access. The operational environment shall support TLS certificate provisioning through Let's Encrypt using DNS-01 validation in the documented virtual-machine environment.
The platform shall persist user, book, and e-commerce site data in MySQL, message-management data in NoSQL storage, and thumbnails or related objects in object storage.
